categories.main_business_segments: Korea Movenex Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three business segments: automotive parts, flanges, and industrial machinery. The automotive parts segment, which includes H/Shaft and Axle assemblies for passenger and commercial vehicles, accounts for 97.6% of sales. The flange segment produces various types of flanges for piping connections, contributing 0.8% of sales, while the industrial machinery segment manufactures components for power plants, ship structures, and other heavy equipment, making up 1.6% of sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in high-precision manufacturing technologies for automotive parts such as H/Shafts and Axles, requiring advanced machining and assembly skills. It operates large-scale forging presses and CNC machining centers for flange production, including a 12,500-ton forging press and robotic production systems. The industrial machinery segment utilizes modern equipment and skilled labor to produce high-quality structural and pressure vessel components, supported by comprehensive quality management systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are major automotive manufacturers, especially Hyundai Motor Group and Kia, to whom the company supplies critical drivetrain components. The flange business serves domestic and international EPC contractors, including Hyundai Heavy Industries and Samsung Engineering, mainly for large-scale plant projects. The industrial machinery segment supplies parts to shipbuilding and power plant industries, with customers like Hyundai Heavy Industries. The company’s products are used in passenger cars, commercial vehicles, power plants, shipbuilding, and construction sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Korea Movenex operates manufacturing facilities in South Korea (Ulsan, Gyeongju) and has overseas production subsidiaries in the United States, China, and Mexico. It maintains a global sales network with regional sales offices and production sites to serve both domestic and international markets. The company’s overseas subsidiaries supply automotive parts to Hyundai-Kia’s overseas plants, supporting global automotive production hubs.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the automotive and industrial supply chains, manufacturing key components such as H/Shafts and Axles that are integral to vehicle assembly. It also produces flanges and industrial machinery parts used in construction and plant engineering projects, positioning itself as a critical parts supplier to OEMs and EPC contractors rather than an end-product assembler or retailer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Korea Movenex focuses its R&D efforts on developing advanced, lightweight, and high-value-added automotive parts, particularly H/Shafts and Axles, in collaboration with Hyundai and Kia for new vehicle models. The company invests heavily in its in-house Seohan Technology Research Institute to lead technological innovation and product refinement. Strategic priorities include enhancing product quality, expanding global production capabilities, and responding to emerging trends such as electric vehicles and SUVs.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of manufactured automotive parts, flanges, and industrial machinery components. Sales are made to OEMs and EPC contractors via direct product sales, including both domestic and export transactions. Revenue is largely volume-driven, linked to automotive production volumes and large-scale plant project orders, with pricing influenced by contracts and raw material costs.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors in the automotive parts segment include Hyundai Wia, Iljin, Myunghwa Industrial, and CTR. Korea Movenex holds an estimated market share of 33% in H/Shafts and 45% in Axles including its affiliates, positioning it as a leading supplier in the Korean automotive parts industry. The company leverages advanced manufacturing technology and strong relationships with Hyundai-Kia to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, Korea Movenex reported consolidated revenues of approximately 1.51 trillion KRW, with a 10.2% year-over-year increase. Operating profit rose by 60.4% to 59.3 billion KRW, reflecting improved profitability. The company’s total assets reached 874.7 billion KRW, with a stable capital structure and a debt-to-equity ratio of 156.4%. It maintains solid financial health with a 39.0% equity ratio and a return on equity (ROE) of 14.8%, demonstrating steady growth and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Korea Movenex emphasizes its advanced manufacturing capabilities, high-precision technology, and strong R&D collaboration with major automakers to deliver high-quality, lightweight, and technologically sophisticated automotive components. Its global production network enables responsive supply to key customers like Hyundai-Kia worldwide. The company’s long-standing expertise, rigorous quality control, and ISO14001 environmental certification further differentiate its products in competitive markets.
